decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line that is still shown on the website in both years, the platter meets aspirations and fits the firm's strategic direction toward organic, so management has no trigger for problemistic search.

The premium sharing snack line is being extended with new variants (Classic, Geflügel), which signals results at or above aspiration, although its drop from a page of its own to a mere mention adds some uncertainty.
The organic Fleischwurst is a recent, low-risk extension of a core product that the firm actively promotes, and its slack allows it to carry the product while early results come in.
The thinly sliced organic chicken line with several variants supports the organic expansion strategy, and one year is too early for a shortfall against aspiration to justify dropping it.

The herb-coated organic salami is new and has its own page, but as a niche single-variant item close to existing salami it could be cut if sales fall short, much as the organic poultry mini snack was.
